strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items (summed over line quantities), the SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, floored at $0, other codes refused), and $4.99 shipping unless discounted goods reach $50 (empty cart costs nothing). All logic is in src/cart.js (cartTotal, bulkDiscount); tests are Vitest unit tests through cartTotal. bulkDiscount uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items gets no discount, contradicting AC1 — that case is expected to fail and is reported as a defect. Revision 2 adds TC12 (SAVE5 taking goods to exactly $0) from PR review feedback.
inScope: cartTotal pricing: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, unknown coupons, shipping threshold, empty cart
Boundaries: 9/10 items, $49.99/$50 goods, coupon equal to and larger than goods
outOfScope: Any UI or API around checkout (none exists in the repo)
Currency rounding beyond the values the cases use
assumptions: cartTotal(items, { coupon }) is the checkout price; items are { price, quantity } as in the existing test
Coupon refusal is a thrown Error; tests check the message names the submitted code (the part the test controls)
A cart whose coupon floors the goods at $0 still pays $4.99 shipping, since only an empty cart is shipped free below $50
Coupon codes are matched exactly (case-sensitive), as the code does
Totals that go through the 10% discount are compared to the cent with toBeCloseTo(value, 2), per PR review
openQuestions: Should a coupon bringing goods to $0 on a non-empty cart still be charged $4.99 shipping? The code and a literal reading of AC3 say yes.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold (code uses > instead of >=)
risks.mitigation: TC1 checks exactly 10 items; kept as expected-to-fail with a recorded defect

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount, changing the total
risks.mitigation: TC4 uses values where the order changes the result

risks.description: Free shipping judged on the subtotal rather than discounted goods
risks.mitigation: TC10 uses a cart whose subtotal is over $50 but discounted goods are under

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never go below $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when the goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1 says a cart with 10 or more items gets 10% off. src/cart.js bulkDiscount uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount. It should use `>=`.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{ price: 10, quantity: 10 }]) returns 100 instead of 90. TC1 is marked it.fails and passes, so its assertion fails.

feedback.author: gregoryduckworth
feedback.body: The helper TC6 and TC7 share is called `act`, which says nothing about what it does. Please name it after what it does (for example `checkoutWith`), so a failure message reads clearly.
